title: Banana and Date Muesli Slice
subtitle: with Pepitas and Shredded Coconut
description: Loaded with wholesome oats, shredded coconut, peanut butter and dates, this muesli slice will fill hungry tummies with all the good stuff, plus it's easy and fun to make! Pop into lunchboxes for work or school, or enjoy for morning or afternoon tea. You'll be counting down to snack time!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 180C. Grease a 20cm square baking pan. Line the base and two sides with a sheet of baking paper, leaving a 2cm overhang on each side. Cut the dates into 1cm chunks. Mash the banana (see Kitchen hacks).
Melt wet ingredients: Put the peanut butter, maple syrup and 2 tbs olive oil in a small saucepan over low heat. Cook, stirring, until melted and combined.
Combine dry ingredients: Meanwhile, combine the oats, coconut and pepitas in a large bowl.

Combine muesli mixture: Pour the peanut butter mixture over the oat mixture and stir to combine. Whisk 1 egg in a separate bowl (see Kitchen hacks), add to the oat mixture and stir until well combined. Stir through the dates and mashed banana.

Bake muesli slice: Spoon the muesli mixture into the prepared pan, then smooth the surface and press down firmly to make an even layer. Bake for 25-30 mins until golden and firm to the touch. Cool completely in the pan, then cut into 8 bars. Enjoy straight away, or store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 1 week.

Kitchen hacks: Make sure your banana is ripe before using. To speed up the ripening process, store it in a loosely closed paper bag for a day or two. ~ You can make this vegan by omitting the egg. It will be more crumbly, but just as delicious.
